interpretation_notes: This is a complete monophonic lead and harmonic/bass map for a three-tone PSG arrangement, not a literal full piano transcription. No lyrics are included.
Use lead_sustained_events for playback: ties are already merged. MIDI null denotes a rest. absolute_beat is zero-based.
All printed bars last four quarter-note beats. Section order expands the implicit repeat from the beginning and correctly skips first ending on pass two.
Printed bar 2 has a small upstem quarter-note alternate for verse two at beat 3; it is included only in the second verse.
Printed bar 14 ends with C#6 whose backing-vocal tie overlaps the next chorus. Monophonic lead yields to A4 at bar 15; optional_backing_voice retains the upper continuation.
Printed bar 14 is labeled Dsus despite an F-natural melody. The symbol is retained verbatim; the PSG root/fifth texture avoids choosing its third.
Printed bar 23 is labeled F# (no minor or power-chord suffix); that label is retained. Its root/fifth realization matches the texture without requiring a third.
Printed bars 29–36 have no fresh chord symbols. Inherited A is labeled, but explicit bass_override must replace static root/fifth patterns for the bridge riff.
Printed bar 42 changes to Dm at beat 0.5, aligned with the natural F. D is retained for the initial tied eighth; root/fifth is unchanged.
Printed bars 42–43 include a tied A5+C#6 dyad. Monophonic upper lead selects C#6; optional lower A5 is retained separately.
Printed bars 53,55,57 contain two-part harmony; original lower melody is lead and upper line is optional_harmony.
Printed bar 44 is N.C. but contains the complete instrumental turnaround melody and matching bass two octaves below; do not silence that bar.
Printed bar 58 changes to N.C. at beat 2 while the written bass cadence continues. Explicit bass_override preserves the final hits.
